$comment: The closed list of what an AI generator is allowed to override. DERIVED FROM the real section contracts and cross-checked against schema/pagespec.schema.json by extraction/verify_all.py -- its section keys, required fields, top-level settable props, asset roles, generatedAssetRoles and retrievalEligible are re-checked against the contracts and the schema on every verify_all run. Anything absent from settableProperties is not settable.

designSystems.marketing: The Webflow-derived marketing site. Theme marketing-light.
designSystems.auth: The app host (/log-in): Vite + React + Mantine. Theme auth-light. A SEPARATE design system -- different grid, breakpoints, spacing, radii and line-height. Its tokens live in tokens/themes/auth-light.json and must never be merged into the marketing set. The two share only the two font families and the brand hexes.

globalRules: A generator may set only the properties listed under a section's settableProperties. Everything else is contract-owned.
Every text field must respect its maxWords budget.
Every media field must carry an assetRole from the closed enum in assets/asset-roles.json, and that role must be in the field's own assetRoles list.

For any role whose generationPolicy is must-reuse-exact (or another non-generative policy with declared files), assetRef must be one of the files that role already declares. A generator may reference an existing asset but must never invent one.
Motion may only use a pattern from the section's allowedMotionPatterns, and reducedMotionFallback must equal the section's declared fallback.
Never emit or imitate the real third-party press marks, the Otter wordmark, brand illustrations, real people's photographs, or operative legal text. See assets/asset-roles.json.
Never reintroduce /sign-up or /welcome as local routes.
Never give an instance of auth.login-form any form of credential submission.

Every PageSpec declares mode: clone (faithful reconstruction; real assets/copy may be referenced) or generation (a different brand: generation-safe roles only, no source identity or content, generationContext required).
In mode:generation only roles whose availability is generation-safe may appear (pinned in code: PINNED_AVAILABILITY).
Page-level tokens go in the closed `tokens` object and must name catalog paths allowed by tokens/llm/token-policy.json; raw colours, lengths and font names are rejected.
Sections with retrievalEligible:false (runtime / empty-state / scaffold UI) are never retrieved as design exemplars.

tokenOverridePolicy.pageLevelTokenSlots: tokens/llm/token-policy.json pageSpecTokenSlots (closed `tokens` object in the PageSpec, added in pageSpecVersion 1.1.0)
tokenOverridePolicy.statement: There is still no per-instance style override inside a section. A PageSpec names a closed set of PAGE-LEVEL tokens (surface, text, fontDisplay, fontBody, sectionPadding, cardRadius, buttonRadius) plus the pre-existing per-node fill enums; schema/semantic_validate.py check_tokens validates them against tokens/llm/token-catalog.json (generated from the token files) and tokens/llm/token-policy.json, with adversarial PageSpec-level mutations for every TOKEN_* rule.

rawValueRestrictions.color: Only the 9 foundation colours in tokens/00-foundation/color.json. No new hex may be introduced.
rawValueRestrictions.elevation: Only the three in tokens/00-foundation/elevation.json; two of them are deliberately untransitioned.
rawValueRestrictions.motion: Only the durations, delays and the one easing curve in tokens/00-foundation/motion.json.
rawValueRestrictions.clipPath: Closed at the 7 ids in tokens/00-foundation/clip-path.json. No new path data.

tokenOverridePolicy.rawValueRestrictionsNote: These category keys are the real top-level/section key names in the token files they govern, so a drift check can resolve each one against something that actually exists rather than against a convenient human label.

field.label.reason: capital N here; /sign-up says "Phone number". A real cross-screen copy inconsistency in the original, preserved.

submit.inert.reason: HARD CONSTRAINT, LOCKED TRUE. See constraints.inertForm.

loadMore.reason: A single 'Load more' pill, rendered for visual fidelity and DELIBERATELY INERT. The original is Finsweet CMS Load v1 pointed at page 2; this clone only holds the 10 real page-1 posts, so there is nothing to load and no extra posts are fabricated to give it something to reveal. It is an <a> with no href, role="button", aria-disabled="true" and a preventDefault click, inside a div[role=navigation][aria-label="List"]. Its CSS pins cursor:pointer so it looks identical to the original's real anchor while still doing nothing. A generated instance must not wire it to real pagination. There is no category filter, no tab bar and no search on this page.

linkColumns.reason: Fixed: column 1 Parents/Sitters/Trust & Safety, column 2 FAQ/Careers/Blog/Contact, column 3 the four social links (all target=_blank). Chrome, not page content.

contentLinks.reason: Fixed on every 'site' route: Parents, Sitters, Trust & Safety, Blog. A PageSpec cannot change this set — it is chrome, not page content.

content.stub-notice.retrievalReason: Scaffold placeholder for the unmeasured 404 route ('not built yet'); it is not a design pattern of the source and must not be retrieved as an exemplar.

emptyState.reason: LOCKED TRUE. Both CMS collections on /faq are genuinely empty on the original: the server HTML ships no item template at all, only Webflow's .w-dyn-empty placeholder. So /faq genuinely has NO FAQ content and NO accordion is rendered on it.

faq.category-empty.retrievalReason: Runtime empty state of an EMPTY CMS collection (the grey 'No items found.' box) repeated per FAQ category; not a reusable content pattern.

emptyState.reason: LOCKED TRUE for the same reason as testimonials.slider-empty. No questions array exists.

faq.common-questions-empty.retrievalReason: Runtime empty state of an EMPTY CMS collection (the grey 'No items found.' box); it carries no question/answer pattern to retrieve.

errorBlock.reason: the .form-error / .w-form-fail block, ported and kept in the DOM but hidden by default

srHeading.reason: h2.u-sr-only — visually hidden, keep for a11y

successBlock.reason: the custom .form-success / .w-form-done block, hidden by default

anchorId.reason: the hero CTA is a plain native #jobs jump — no smooth-scroll JS is attached

emptyState.reason: LOCKED TRUE. The CMS collection behind this slider is genuinely empty on the live original, so the site renders Webflow's grey 'No items found.' box and the clone reproduces it. There is deliberately NO items array a generator could populate — inventing testimonial copy for a real company is forbidden.

testimonials.slider-empty.retrievalReason: Runtime empty state of an EMPTY CMS collection (the grey 'No items found.' box); retrieving it as a testimonial exemplar would teach an empty slider.

video.clickToPlay.reason: HARD CONSTRAINT, LOCKED TRUE. The original ships 0 iframes, 0 <video> elements and 0 third-party requests on load. The iframe is injected only after a user click. A generated instance must never autoplay or embed on load.
